newsitem.title: DUBAI: Two letter bombs sent to Arab newspaper in Riyadh.
newsitem.headline: Two letter bombs sent to Arab newspaper in Riyadh.

text.p: The Riyadh bureau of the Arabic-language newspaper al-Hayat has received two letter bombs mailed from Egypt over the last 10 days, a source close to the daily said on Tuesday.
"The first was received on January 4 and the second on January 11," said the source, who requested anonymity.
"Both were discovered before they went off and removed by police."
He gave no further details. Officials would not comment.
The London-based daily has been a target of several letter bombs at its offices in London and the United States.
